headline: As of 2026-10-08: 2,075,660 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 33 of 50 states, D+29.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 2,075,660 early/mail ballots cast so far across 33 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+29.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (422,252), Florida (358,491), Michigan (252,707).
